title: Mollification of Lipschitz maps: C^∞ Λ-Lipschitz approximants within Λ/(j + 1)
statement: For all N, N' ∈ ℕ, Λ ∈ ℝ≥0 and every Λ-Lipschitz map F : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} there are maps F_j : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} (j ∈ ℕ), each C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)) and Λ-Lipschitz, with |F_j(x) − F(x)| ≤ Λ/(j + 1) for all j ∈ ℕ and x ∈ ℝ^N.
lean_statement: ∀ (N N' : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (F : Euclid N → Euclid N'), LipschitzWith Λ F → ∃ Fs : ℕ → Euclid N → Euclid N', (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (Fs j)) ∧ (∀ j, LipschitzWith Λ (Fs j)) ∧ ∀ (j : ℕ) (x : Euclid N), dist (Fs j x) (F x) ≤ (Λ : ℝ) / ((j : ℝ) + 1)
